howto.name: How to Document Wind Damage for Insurance Claims

steps.name: Capture Timestamped Photos
steps.text: Take clear photos of all damaged areas, including close-ups of lifted shingles, granule piles, and interior water stains. Use your phone's timestamp feature to establish damage occurrence timing.

steps.name: Record Weather Conditions
steps.text: Note the date, time, and reported wind speeds from the National Weather Service for the storm event. This documentation supports your insurance claim with official weather verification.

steps.name: Create a Damage Inventory
steps.text: List all visible damage with specific locations on the roof, such as north-facing slopes or valley areas most vulnerable to wind uplift in Cottonwood Heights.

steps.name: Contact Your Insurance Adjuster
steps.text: Schedule an adjuster inspection within 72 hours of damage discovery. When your adjuster inspects, Frame Restoration Utah can meet them on site to walk through the documented damage.

steps.name: Preserve Repair Estimates
steps.text: Keep detailed written estimates from licensed Utah contractors that break down materials, labor, and warranty coverage for transparency.
